source: papers/sector_thesis.tex, Table 1 (tab:cases); full arguments in papers/duality_sector.tex and its six dated addenda

verdict_vocabulary.forced: Self-dual point on a discrete fixed-point set exchanging two inequivalent, gapped sectors; forced to be the transition.
verdict_vocabulary.not_forced: Self-dual point on a continuous moduli space with enhanced symmetry; a point like any other, not a cause.
verdict_vocabulary.constraint: Self-duality, if the fixed point is self-dual, pins an exact number; the dynamics causes the transition.
verdict_vocabulary.organisation: The duality organises a diagram; a different mechanism does the causing.
verdict_vocabulary.preferred_equilibrium: Both dual sectors populated and competing; the self-dual point is a preferred equilibrium, not a transition.
verdict_vocabulary.open_question: The duality is verified, but the literature does not settle whether a self-dual point exists or is distinguished.
verdict_vocabulary.excluded_not_a_duality: Not a verdict of the criterion: on reading the primary literature, the candidate is not a duality at all.
verdict_vocabulary.excluded_no_self_map: Not a verdict of the criterion: the duality relates different theories, so there is no fixed point to ask about.

cases.name: Ising (Kramers-Wannier)
cases.why: Discrete fixed point; order/disorder sectors inequivalent and gapped.
cases.note: The Ising duality itself is cited, not formalised here. SectorDuality proves the Z_N Fourier skeleton (its N=2 case is Kramers-Wannier gauging applied twice); it does not prove the Ising critical temperature.

cases.name: SO(3) Yang-Mills at theta = pi
cases.why: Self-dual point separates a Z2 TQFT from the trivial phase; anomaly-forced.
cases.note: The forcing mechanism is an anomaly argument, not the duality map (duality_sector.tex, addendum 1).

cases.name: Potts / random-cluster (q >= 1)
cases.why: Self-dual point IS the critical point, proved for every q, continuous or not.
cases.note: Self-duality pins where the transition is, not its order: continuous for 1<=q<=4, discontinuous for q>4 (separate theorems). Added 2026-09-27 (duality_sector.tex, addendum 6).

cases.name: String-gas cosmology
cases.why: Both winding and momentum sectors populated and compete.
cases.note: The Hagedorn exit is a sector event (winding annihilation); T-duality is the symmetry of the spectrum it is described in.

cases.name: Compact boson / BKT
cases.why: Continuous line of fixed points; R = sqrt2 (self-dual) differs from 2*sqrt2 (vortex threshold).
cases.note: Key theorems: QuantumFluids.CompactBoson.partition_dual, electric_mul_magnetic, selfDual_radius, vortex_marginal_radius, bkt_not_selfDual.

cases.name: Superconductor-insulator transition
cases.why: Duality pins a resistance if self-dual; vortex/charge proliferation causes the transition.

cases.name: Quantum Hall, Gamma_0(2) / Fricke
cases.why: Organises the plateau diagram; Laughlin's argument causes quantisation.
cases.note: The Fricke element fixes the critical orbit but is not a symmetry of the plateaux (QHFricke).

cases.name: RCFT / Verlinde (su(2) level 1)
cases.why: Self-dual radius on a continuous line of RCFT fixed points.
cases.note: RCFTDuality proves a 2x2 integer-matrix identity (S^2 = 2*1, symmetric, det = -2); that this matrix IS the su(2)_1 Kac-Peterson S-matrix is representation theory supplied as prose, not checked.

cases.name: Particle-vortex / level-rank duality (FQHE, nu = 1/2)
cases.why: Forces an exact Berry phase and Hall conductance; not itself a transition.
cases.note: LevelRankDuality proves only the Young-diagram box-transpose bijection, not S,T-matrix preservation. At N=K the labels close up but the physics does not (Hsin-Seiberg Eq. 4.18: SU(N)_N relates to its level reversal) -- no self-dual-point question there (addendum 6).

cases.name: K3 x T^2 dyon lattice; D1-D5-P-KK sequel
cases.paper_case: K3$\times T^2$ dyon lattice; D1-D5-P-KK sequel
cases.why: Class number counts sectors at fixed entropy; attractor mechanism causes moduli.
cases.note: disc_sl2_invariant transfers verbatim to the 4D-lifted D1-D5-P-KK dyon; the class-number statement does not; Strominger-Vafa/Callan-Maldacena formulas are out of scope.

cases.name: Seiberg duality (4D N=1 SQCD)
cases.why: Conformal window is one continuous phase; N_c = N_f/2 not distinguished.
cases.note: Prose only: the formalisable content of N_c -> N_f - N_c is a one-line integer involution.

cases.name: Montonen-Olive S-duality (N=4 SYM)
cases.why: tau = i, rho are enhanced-symmetry points on a continuous coupling.
cases.note: No project Lean file needed: Mathlib's own Mathlib.NumberTheory.Modular proves the stabiliser facts. Open caveat: at tau=i, S maps the theory to itself only after exchanging global forms (SU(N) vs PSU(N)).

cases.name: Calabi-Yau mirror symmetry
cases.why: No citable self-mirror threefold exists; duality itself verified as T-duality.
cases.note: Mirror symmetry generically relates two different manifolds; a rigid CY (h^{2,1}=0) has no smooth mirror. Mathlib has no Calabi-Yau content.

cases.name: Topological superconductors / tenfold way
cases.note: The Kitaev chain = transverse-field Ising (Jordan-Wigner) link is the already-claimed Ising case, not a new instance.

cases.name: 3D Ising / Wegner duality
cases.why: Maps to a different theory (a Z2 gauge theory).
